scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: eslint artifacts/api-server/src artifacts/proofstack/app artifacts/proofstack/components artifacts/proofstack/hooks artifacts/proofstack/lib artifacts/proofstack/proxy.ts lib/db/src tests lib/db/tests
scripts.format: prettier --write docs tests artifacts/api-server/src artifacts/proofstack/app artifacts/proofstack/components artifacts/proofstack/hooks artifacts/proofstack/lib artifacts/proofstack/proxy.ts lib/db/src lib/db/tests .github eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.embedded.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check docs tests artifacts/api-server/src artifacts/proofstack/app artifacts/proofstack/components artifacts/proofstack/hooks artifacts/proofstack/lib artifacts/proofstack/proxy.ts lib/db/src lib/db/tests .github eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.embedded.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
